name: Aku no Gyoumu Nisshi
source:
Main character leaves an absolutely ordinary life with his salary-man father, housewife mother and private school student sister. But he suddenly gets appointed to the post of a commander of an evil organization. Huh? Is he even suited for fighting with no unique qualities?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
